description: Nvidia Nemotron 3.5 30B A3B BF16 by bartowski
gpu_tip: ~68GB total, even at the full 262K context — Nemotron 3.5 is a hybrid Mamba/MoE architecture (only 6 of 52 layers are full attention, with just 2 KV heads), so unlike a dense model this size KV cache barely grows with context; the total is essentially the BF16 file size plus a small state-space margin. A 16GB GPU (e.g. RTX 4080) plus a 64GB DDR5 kit covers it, with llama.cpp offloading the inactive routed experts to system RAM.
mac_tip: Needs ~68GB — comfortable on a 96GB M4 Max/M5 Max.
